title: Prove the exact two-image inverse input lattice (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove the exact dyadic Gaussian inverse-input lattice for both original and phase-repaired prefixes in Cinna Davis's #4998. Claim type: scoped all-width proof with finite corroboration.

For D = Z[i,1/2], n = 8^f, a = (4^f+2^f)/2 and b = (8^f-4^f)/4:

~~~text
coker_D G_f = (D/(3))^a direct-sum (D/(15))^b
safe inverse-input fraction = 9^(-a-b) * 25^(-b)
least odd denominator for unrestricted exact inputs = 15
~~~

The safe fraction is exactly 1/164025 at width one. The source already supplies an inverse with denominator 15. This adds necessity, the full quotient and explicit framed input congruences. It answers the exact-grid feasibility part of #4998 Open next question 2. No new kappa, paid-call improvement or selected-frontier change is claimed.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Cinna Davis #4998/#4991, lee-phys #4688, Yiyang #4710, Dugongue #4743, Jacob Alan Sussman #4628, eumemic #288 and Swapnil Jain P1/P2. Classical cyclic-module presentation tools retain their ordinary attribution. Predecessor programs are neither imported nor audited.

## Evidence

Before, denominator 15 is sufficient and the exact-grid realization remains open. After, the written module proof gives the complete safe lattice and proves both odd primes unavoidable on unrestricted literal inputs.

- Enumerated cycles at widths 1 through 5.
- Exhausted 50,865 real cycle residues. Safe counts are 5, 75 and 3375 for lengths 1, 2 and 4.
- Four literal Gaussian realifications have ranks modulo (3,5) of (8,14) at width one and (84,104) at width two, for both variants.
- Independent rational inversion checks the sharp denominator, 128 input-membership probes and 32 forward-image columns. Unweighted congruences and single-prime replacements have counterexamples.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized direct replays pass locally in 0.459 s and 0.447 s. These are check durations, not speed comparisons.
- Registered replay and committed-byte/source-history checks pass at 06611c07c1640bc6976678bbd744deabd70294c6. The verifier prints fresh package-file hashes and results; no receipt is hand-written.

From the worktree root, CPython 3.12 and the standard library:

~~~sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/two-image-inverse-lattice/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/two-image-inverse-lattice/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/two-image-inverse-lattice
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/two-image-inverse-lattice --check-source-history
~~~

Expected markers are PASS_TWO_IMAGE_INVERSE_LATTICE, PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE and PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES. Any CPython 3.12 path can replace the local interpreter. The direct verifier requires no Git or predecessor files.

## Limitations

The all-width claim rests on the written proof. Finite enumeration corroborates it. The obstruction concerns literal D-valued outputs. Rational encodings, odd-denominator arithmetic, rounded outputs and deliberately safe-lattice inputs remain possible. Complete-period density is not an assertion about an actual caller's distribution. Finite powers-of-two precision, physical preparation/storage/routing, Gaussian consumers and supplier admission remain unpriced.

Every registered command ran locally. Lean, Docker and the selected scientific cold replay are unrun. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No complete multiplication theorem follows.

## Open next questions

- Bind one actual independent-input producer to the safe-lattice congruences and charge its complete preparation/restoration bill. No favorable producer is supplied.
- Implement one rationally encoded or rounded invocation with an explicit return contract and complete numerical/storage/routing costs.

## Related open work

- #4628 develops the small-unit engine and its lower bounds, leaving five-in-fourteen open. This arithmetic boundary for a derived inverse partner does not settle that construction or compare call-count bounds.

The final scan covered all 331 open PR bodies and found no open PR studying this exact inverse lattice. Main-tree formula searches, merged work and live claims were checked again before committing. Sparse local notes, arbitrary unseen diffs and unpublished work limit overlap coverage. Canonical [advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19141364).
